snippet.title: A Tactical Narrative-driven Roguelite RPG - Hidden Pass - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the Wanderer—explorer, warrior, and tactician all in one.

Lead a crew of skyfaring heroes, wield techno-magical relics, and command automatons as you unravel the secrets of the floating isles. Every step is a gamble—will you uncover glory or be lost to the winds?

Turn-based combat meets roguelite tension in a world rich with mystery and danger. Ready to take flight?

If you have played classics like X-Com, Divinity OS, Darkest Dungeon or enjoyed some newer releases: Tactical Breach Wizards, Rogue Waters  - give Hidden Pass a try! 

Our social links:
-Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430170/Hidden_Pass/?utm_source=YouTube)
-Discord to be more up-to-date and involved ( https://discord.gg/GuhRb9N9Dq)
-Twitter (https://twitter.com/GGstudiodev)
